products.name: GIMP
products.scope: Official desktop GIMP; unrelated similarly named mobile apps and third-party bundles are excluded.

claims.summary: Official GIMP is freely distributed GNU GPL software for image manipulation.

claims.proposedValue: Free official desktop software under GNU GPL; not a paid one-time license.
claims.summary: The official project distributes free software for retouching and image composition.

claims.proposedValue: Camera RAW processing uses external plug-ins; CMYK handling is not a full native CMYK editing workflow according to the FAQ.
claims.summary: FAQ describes RAW plug-ins and CMYK import/export through RGB storage, without a timeline for CMYK as a core image format.
FAQ explicitly discusses Photoshop replacement/comparison, but scoped photo-retouching and composition fit still needs editorial review; no feature-parity guarantee.

products.name: Krita
products.scope: Official GPL application for digital painting; store distribution can be paid, while artwork belongs to its creator.

claims.summary: GPL permits use for any purpose, including commercial artwork; official free distribution is distinct from paid store builds.

claims.proposedValue: Free GPL application; optional paid Microsoft Store and Steam distribution supports development.
claims.summary: License page distinguishes free software rights from paid store distribution.

claims.proposedValue: Photoshop workflows do not map directly: group compositing, masks and smart-layer equivalents use different mechanisms; not all layer-style functionality is supported.
claims.summary: Official migration manual documents specific layer and tool differences. It does not establish complete PSD fidelity or general Photoshop parity.
Official Photoshop migration guide supports a painting-oriented comparison; reviewer must approve the route's stated editing scope.

unresolved: Keep digital painting positioning explicit rather than presenting universal photo-editing replacement.
Confirm current official download platforms and exact version.

products.name: Paint.NET
products.scope: Classic desktop release; proprietary freeware. Paid Microsoft Store distribution is a separate channel.

claims.summary: Classic release is free for personal and organizational use; paid Store release has the same functionality with automatic updating.

claims.proposedValue: Classic release is free; Microsoft Store release is paid. This freeware license is not open source.
claims.summary: License permits use but prohibits modifying the application; do not infer GPL rights from free pricing.

claims.proposedValue: The application cannot be modified under its license; redistribution of plugins requires their authors' permission.
claims.summary: Official license distinguishes application redistribution and plugin permissions.
Official layers, adjustments and effects support overlap with basic image/photo editing. Scope is narrower than complete Photoshop replacement.
